summary: The registrant, Prospect Floating Rate and Alternative Income Fund, Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine monthly base distribution declared by its Board of Directors on August 21, 2026. The distribution targets an annualized rate of 10.0% of net asset value for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with per-share amounts of $0.03242 for Class A and Class I shares. Record date is August 31, 2026; payment date September 8, 2026. The filing details tax attribute determination and notes distributions may include return of capital. This is a standard distribution announcement, not a special situation.
